name: – Carmen Crespo Díaz – After recital AD – Am 11
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text: ADb. whereas the Commission’s 2024 implementation report finds that the mixed trends in demersal stocks and in the profitability of the fisheries concerned also result from delays in implementation and limited ownership by Member States, including increases in catches of juvenile fish, structural overcapacity, increased use of twin trawling and shortcomings in control and enforcement in some Member States;
